_about: The fact database. A fact that appears on more than one page lives here once and is rendered everywhere it is needed, so one verified change propagates across the site. status: verified = an editor read the cited source and it supports the value; reported = credible reports or a located official page say so but an editor has not confirmed it; not_verified = carried over from earlier copy with no source; disputed = sources disagree (every alternative is shown, none is silently chosen). A verified fact needs source.url, verifiedAt and verifiedBy. 'topic' decides how quickly it goes stale (data/site-config.json > freshness).

facts.subject: Kumbh Mela passes and registration
facts.fact: A general-visitor e-pass or registration is required to attend
facts.display: Not confirmed — no such requirement has been found in official sources

source.name: Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Authority

facts.notes: What has been reported: online registration for religious and charitable organisations (QR single-window) and for student volunteers ('Kumbhdoot'), and administrative approval for a web portal and mobile app. A general-pilgrim e-pass has not been announced in any source we could locate. Until the Authority says otherwise, do not tell visitors a pass is required or that none is.
